rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
V = IR
P = IV = I²R = V²/R
V_term = E − Ir

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Electromotive force" as one blob → ✅ split into: electromotive force, internal resistance, cells in combination.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Ohm's law: V = IR; R = ρL/A (resistivity ρ depends on material).  ·  Series: R = ΣR; same I, voltages add. Parallel: 1/R = Σ1/R; same V, currents add.
